text:
isabella: Hi all 1- excited to introduce Frank Rivera who joins the Eng-Platform team today as a SRE/Infra engineer. Frank, welcome! :tada:
frank: Thanks @isabella! thrilled to be here. Quick question: where do I put my hardware preferences for a work laptop (GPU vs no-GPU)?
marie: welcome @frank! we ask new hires to fill the "hardware request" form in Notion (link in #new-hires pinned). If you need a GPU machine for local CUDA tests we usually provision remote dev boxes instead.
onboarding-bot: New hire checklist: "Frank Rivera" added to Slack, Google Workspace, and payroll. Still missing: 2FA setup and badge.
frank: got it. I'll fill the Notion form now. Also, small fun fact: I build custom analog synths on weekends.
kai: love that! synths are a mood. @frank for badge and building access ping @oliver. For VPN + GCP service account, tag @tess.
oliver: added: I'll schedule a campus tour and badge pickup tomorrow at 10am.
tess: FYI @frank I just invited you to the infra-ops Google group and created a service account stub. You'll need to add 2FA before the invite shows details.
frank: thanks all. one more: I tried joining the eng-platform repo but got a 403 on cloning. who handles perms?
marie: ping @isabella for repo and CI roles, she can add you to the team org.
isabella: done, invited you to the org and granted read access to eng-platform. Let me know if you need write for the infra-ci pipelines.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: New hire orientation at 3pm PT. "Frank Rivera" is registered.
frank: appreciate everyone making the onboarding smooth. looking forward to the runbook walkthrough tomorrow. :wave:
